messages:
evan: New RFP from Meridian Health — main asks: EU-hosted private deployment, HSM keywrap (FIPS), 3-week POC with redacted dataset, 200 rps burst for embeddings, signed security questionnaire and capability matrix. Also asked for an exec risk slide.

claire: I'll own the security questionnaire and capability matrix. Note: HSM onboarding 4-6w, no FedRAMP. Will prefill and mark HSM as timeline-dependent.

marco: Ops notes: we can provision Private control plane in eu-west-1. HSM is the blocker for day-1 envelope keys; recommend temporary BYOK via customer KMS as mitigation. Latency target: 95th <180ms with Dedicated small + batching.

evan: Pricing ballpark: POC (3w) $18k, Private setup $11k one-time, Dedicated reserve 1mo $27k, Burst license $5.5k/mo, HSM professional services $13k.

ida: Proposed POC runbook: week0 peer+creds; week1 synthetic perf; week2 redacted run; week3 tuning+demo. Assign owners? evan sales comms, marco infra, claire security, ida bench.

ops-bot: File uploaded: s3://redwood-rfps/meridian/meridian_rfp_packet_v1.zip (owner: claire)

claire: Uploaded capability_matrix.xlsx and sec_questionnaire_filled.pdf to the packet. I'll add a SOC2 summary and note DPA addendum needed for EU residency.

evans: Evan (typo fix) — I'll draft the one-slide risk/mitigation and circulate for signoff.

evans: Small ask: can legal expedite DPA addendum? buyer expects countersign path.

claire: Legal notified. Expect initial DPA addendum draft in 2 business days.

evans: Great — I'll attach and submit to portal once we have the zip and slide. :thumbsup:
